note: Tool primer set vs published (journal/thesis) primer set, where cited. Published sequences are never invented — see each row's published_source.

rows.role_note: cross-system RT-overhang + forward concordance vs a DIFFERENT universal stem-loop system (Czimmerer 2013). The 6-nt RT overhang (the miRNA-specific biological invariant) matches across systems even though the stem-loop bodies differ.
rows.published_source: Czimmerer Z, et al. A Versatile Method to Design Stem-Loop Primer-Based Quantitative PCR Assays. PLoS ONE 2013;8(1):e55168. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0055168, Table 2 (mmu-mir-1; sequence identical to hsa-miR-1-3p). NOTE: different universal body (GTTGGCTCTGG...CCAGAGCCAAC) and reverse (GTGCAGGGTCCGAGGT), so no full-RT exact-match applies — only the 6-nt overhang and the forward miRNA-specific core are comparable.

rows.role_note: SECOND full-RT EXACT-MATCH anchor. Uses the identical Chen-2005 universal body as this tool; RT primer is byte-identical. Verified: 3' UUGUGA -> revcomp TCACAA matches the published stem-loop 3' overhang.
rows.published_source: Ngo Thi Mai Vy (student ID 20187223). 'Development of the Quantification Procedure for miR-125b-5p in Human Plasma Samples Using Stemloop RT-qPCR.' Bachelor's thesis (lab internal, unpublished). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body; universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC (18 nt, a different loop window than this tool's fixed 20-nt reverse, so reverse is not exact-matched). RT overhang TCACAA = revcomp of 3'-terminal UUGUGA (independently verified).

rows.role_note: cross-system forward-primer concordance vs a DIFFERENT universal stem-loop system (Yang 2014 USLP) — validates the miRNA-specific forward-primer principle across independent chemistries
rows.published_source: Yang L-h, et al. Universal Stem-Loop Primer Method. PLoS ONE 2014;9(12):e115293. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0115293 — miR-150 forward qPCR primer (5' GC tail added to raise Tm). NOTE: Yang 2014 uses a different stem-loop body and reverse (random 3' end), so only the forward miRNA-specific core is comparable; no RT exact-match applies.

rows.role_note: common reference/normalizer miRNA; EXACT-MATCH anchor vs a published stem-loop primer set using the identical Chen-2005 universal body + reverse
rows.published_source: Nguyen Hoang Thao Vy, Nguyen Thi Ngoc Thanh, Huynh Huu Luan, Nguyen Thi Hue (2020). 'Designing a stem-loop RT-qPCR method for measuring miRNA-16 expression in human plasma samples.' Proceedings of the National Conference on Biotechnology 2020 (Hoi nghi Cong nghe Sinh hoc Toan quoc 2020), Vietnam, pp. 181-186. Human Genetics Group, Faculty of Biology and Biotechnology, University of Science, Vietnam National University Ho Chi Minh City (the same lab as this tool). Funded by VNU-HCM grant 562-2020-18-02/HD-KHCN. Table 1 'Sequence and characteristics of the stem-loop RT-qPCR primers set'. Domestic conference proceedings, not indexed in PubMed (confirmed by search, zero hits) — not a peer-reviewed journal article. Uses the same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body and universal reverse as this tool; the tool's RT primer and reverse are byte-identical to this published set. NOTE: Table 1 lists the published universal reverse as 'CCAGTGCAGGGCCGAGGTA' (19 nt; the table's own length column also inconsistently says 16 bp) — one nt different from this tool's fixed 20-nt universal reverse 'CCAGTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTA'. Flagged as an apparent transcription anomaly in the source table, not independently resolved; not scored as a mismatch here.

rows.role_note: cross-system RT-overhang + forward concordance vs Czimmerer 2013 (different universal body). Confirms the deterministic overhang rule holds for a 23-nt miRNA in an independent published assay.
rows.published_source: Czimmerer Z, et al. PLoS ONE 2013;8(1):e55168. DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0055168, Table 2 (hsa-mir-181a). Different universal body/reverse — overhang + forward-core comparison only.

rows.role_note: forward-core concordance + demonstrates the Chen 6-8 nt binding range. The published RT used a 7-nt overhang (GCCAATA = revcomp of 3' UAUUGGC... last 7 nt), whereas this tool uses a fixed 6-nt overhang (GCCAAT). No 6-nt RT exact-match is asserted; only the forward-specific core is scored.
rows.published_source: Zhao F-L, Dou Y-C, Wang X-F, Han D-C, Lv Z-G, Ge S-L, Zhang Y-K. 'Serum microRNA-195 is down-regulated in breast cancer: a potential marker for the diagnosis of breast cancer.' Mol Biol Rep. 2014;41(9):5913-5922. DOI 10.1007/s11033-014-3466-1, Table 2 ('The sequences of miR-16 and miR-195 stem-loop RT and PCR primers'). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body (GTCGTATCCAGTGCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTCGCACTGGATACGAC) and universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC. NOTE: the published RT hybridizes 7 nt (GCCAATA = revcomp of 3'-terminal UAUUGGC); this tool's fixed 6-nt overhang (GCCAAT) is the 6-nt prefix of it — a deliberate design choice within Chen's 6-8 nt binding range, not a mismatch. Forward-specific core comparison only.

rows.role_note: canonical positive control; widely published stem-loop assay target

FOURTH full-RT EXACT-MATCH anchor (sibling of miR-222-3p; family 221-3p/222-3p). Identical Chen-2005 universal body; RT primer byte-identical. Verified: 3' GGUUUC -> revcomp GAAACC matches the published stem-loop 3' overhang.
rows.published_source: Tran Thuy Linh. 'Xay dung quy trinh dinh luong miR-221-3p trong huyet tuong bang phuong phap stemloop RT-qPCR' (Building a quantification procedure for miR-221-3p in plasma by stem-loop RT-qPCR). Bachelor's thesis (lab internal, unpublished). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body; universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC (18-nt loop window, not exact-matched vs this tool's 20-nt reverse). RT overhang GAAACC = revcomp of 3'-terminal GGUUUC (independently verified).

rows.role_note: THIRD full-RT EXACT-MATCH anchor. Identical Chen-2005 universal body; RT primer byte-identical. Verified: 3' CUGGGU -> revcomp ACCCAG matches the published stem-loop 3' overhang.
rows.published_source: Le Tran Bao Bao. 'Xay dung quy trinh dinh luong miR-222-3p trong huyet tuong bang phuong phap stemloop RT-qPCR' (Building a quantification procedure for miR-222-3p in plasma by stem-loop RT-qPCR). Bachelor's thesis (lab internal, unpublished). Same Chen-2005 universal stem-loop body; universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC (18-nt loop window, not exact-matched vs this tool's 20-nt reverse). RT overhang ACCCAG = revcomp of 3'-terminal CUGGGU (independently verified). Published amplicon 56 bp.

rows.role_note: forward-core concordance. Published forward (GGCGCC tail + ATAAAGCTAGATAAC) anchors the miRNA 5' prefix. Qualitative support for the short-duplex Tm caveat: the published table lists the 50-nt stem-loop primer Tm as 16 C, illustrating why a point Tm on the 6-nt binding duplex is not meaningful.
rows.published_source: Truong Gia Hung. 'Xay dung quy trinh dinh luong miR-9-3p trong huyet tuong bang phuong phap stemloop RT-qPCR' (Building a quantification procedure for miR-9-3p in plasma by stem-loop RT-qPCR). Bachelor's thesis (lab internal, unpublished), 'Bang 3.2'. Universal reverse GCAGGGTCCGAGGTATTC. Forward-specific core comparison only (stem-loop 3' overhang in the source table was not machine-legible).
